notes:
Summary: Obsidian Controls is a 1500+ employee industrial controls vendor building an AI assistant for field engineers and safety automation. Primary constraint: must run in an air-gapped on-prem appliance with HSM-backed keys and no external control plane telemetry. POC: ran for 3 weeks; Redwood hosted/dedicated approach delivered on latency and cost targets but security team rejected any solution that relied on Redwood-managed control plane or telemetry.

Key quotes: 'We cannot have any outbound management channels from our factory VLAN' — Head of InfoSec.

Why lost: Customer procurement chose LocalOps appliance (on-prem box) because it delivered a certified air-gapped deployment and HSM integration within their procurement timeline. Also internal reorg removed the original champion in OT, reducing sponsor momentum.

Technical constraints: must support FIPS HSM, SAML SSO via internal IdP, no outbound telemetry, local model hosting, token-level auditing for 7 years. Redwood Private roadmap discussed but timeline >6 months — too slow for their go-live.

Sales notes / recommended follow-up: mark as closed-lost; keep security Q&A doc in account folder; set reminder Q3 2025 to check if appliance proves operationally costly (potential expansion/opportunity). Short internal note: consider packaging an air-gapped appliance offering or partner with appliance vendors for a later motion.
